nodes.name: GridConfigEditor.tsx
nodes.summary: Editor for grid-trading strategy parameters — grid count, total investment, leverage, ATR-based or manual price bounds, distribution shape, drawdown/stop-loss limits, maker-only and direction-bias options — plus the exported defaultGridConfig.

nodes.name: GridConfigEditor
nodes.summary: Renders grouped form controls that mutate GridStrategyConfig fields via onChange, honoring the disabled flag and localized labels.

nodes.name: GridRiskPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Live grid-risk monitor that polls per-trader GridRiskInfo on an auto-refresh interval (default 5s) and renders drawdown/exposure status with an expandable detail section.

nodes.name: GridRiskPanel
nodes.summary: Fetches grid risk info for a trader via useAutoRefresh, tracks loading/error state, and renders risk gauges plus expandable warnings.

nodes.name: PublishSettingsEditor.tsx
nodes.summary: Toggle panel controlling strategy publishing: public/private visibility and whether the full config is visible to other users.

nodes.name: PublishSettingsEditor
nodes.summary: Renders the isPublic and configVisible toggle cards with gradient styling and localized labels.

nodes.name: TokenEstimateBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Debounced prompt-token estimator: posts the current strategy config to the backend estimate endpoint and renders total tokens against per-model context limits with usage-level suggestions.

nodes.name: TokenEstimateBar
nodes.summary: Debounces config changes, fetches TokenEstimateResult from the API, and displays model context-limit usage bars plus suggestions.

nodes.name: AccountSelector.tsx
nodes.summary: Portal-based dropdown listing a trader's broker accounts (e.g. NT8 SIM vs live): SIM accounts are selectable, live accounts are greyed out and disabled, and the current account shows a checkmark; switching calls the accounts API.

nodes.name: AccountSelector
nodes.summary: Fetches AccountsResponse via SWR, positions the portal dropdown from the trigger rect, and performs the select-account API call with notify feedback.

nodes.name: DecisionCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Card rendering a single AI DecisionRecord: per-action ActionCard blocks with entry/stop/take-profit, percent-change math, confidence coloring, chain-of-thought reasoning, and futures-aware leverage hiding (CME has no exchange leverage).

nodes.name: calcPctChange
nodes.summary: Computes the signed percent change from entry to a target price respecting trade direction.

nodes.name: ActionCard
nodes.summary: Renders one decision action with ACTION_CONFIG styling (long/short/close), price levels, percent moves, confidence, and leverage when applicable.

nodes.name: DecisionCard
nodes.summary: Top-level decision card mapping DecisionRecord actions to ActionCards, with reasoning expansion and symbol click-through.

nodes.name: ExchangeConfigModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Large multi-step wizard modal for adding and managing exchange/broker credentials across CEX, DEX, and NinjaTrader templates: API-key entry, two-stage private-key capture, WebCrypto environment gating, and delete/verify flows.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports 10+ exchange templates (Binance/Bybit/OKX/... plus Hyperliquid/Aster DEX and NinjaTrader) behind one wizard, delegating sensitive key entry to TwoStageKeyModal.

nodes.name: StepIndicator
nodes.summary: Wizard progress indicator rendering the numbered configuration steps with active/done styling.

nodes.name: ExchangeCard
nodes.summary: Selectable card presenting one exchange template (icon, name, CEX/DEX type) in the picker grid.

nodes.name: ExchangeConfigModal
nodes.summary: Main modal orchestrating template selection, credential forms, two-stage private-key entry, WebCrypto status gating, and exchange CRUD via the API client.

nodes.name: ModelConfigModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-step modal for adding or editing AI model API configurations: a model-selection step followed by provider-specific credential forms (Claw402 pay-per-call catalog and standard API-key providers).

nodes.name: ModelConfigModal
nodes.summary: Top-level modal orchestrating the two-step model configuration wizard — tracks selected model and API key/base URL/model name state, prefills when editing, and dispatches onSave/onDelete/onClose callbacks.

nodes.name: ModelSelectionStep
nodes.summary: First wizard step listing available AI models as selectable ModelCard entries and marking models that are already configured.

nodes.name: Claw402ConfigForm
nodes.summary: Credential form for the Claw402 pay-per-call provider: captures the API key and model choice from the CLAW402_MODELS catalog with extensive localized inline guidance and pricing details.

nodes.name: StandardProviderConfigForm
nodes.summary: Credential form for standard AI providers capturing API key, optional custom base URL, and model name, with per-provider defaults from AI_PROVIDER_CONFIG.

nodes.name: ModelStepIndicator.tsx
nodes.summary: Small step-progress indicator rendering numbered dots and labels for the current step of the model configuration wizard.

nodes.name: ModelStepIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders the numbered step markers with active/completed styling based on currentStep and the provided labels.

nodes.name: PositionHistory.tsx
nodes.summary: Trader position-history dashboard section: fetches closed-position records and aggregate statistics via the API and renders stat cards, per-symbol and long/short direction breakdowns, and a detailed position table.

nodes.name: StatCard
nodes.summary: Metric summary card with title, formatted value, optional suffix/subtitle, and a metric-definition tooltip.

nodes.name: SymbolStatsRow
nodes.summary: Table row showing per-symbol trade count, win rate, and profit/loss totals.

nodes.name: DirectionStatsCard
nodes.summary: Card summarizing long or short direction performance (trades, win rate, P&L) with localized labels via t().

nodes.name: PositionRow
nodes.summary: Table row for a single closed position: side, entry/exit prices and timestamps, holding duration, and realized P&L formatting.

nodes.name: PositionHistory
nodes.summary: Main exported component that loads a trader's position history and statistics from the API, manages symbol filters and pagination, and composes the stat cards, breakdown sections, and position table.

nodes.name: TelegramConfigModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-step modal for connecting a Telegram bot: saves the bot token, confirms the chat binding, and selects which configured AI model is bound to Telegram interactions.

nodes.name: StepIndicator
nodes.summary: Numbered step indicator for the Telegram setup wizard, styling active and completed steps.

nodes.name: TelegramConfigModal
nodes.summary: Wizard modal loading existing Telegram config and enabled AI models in parallel, then walking through token save, bind verification, and unbind actions against the telegram API.

nodes.name: BoundModelSelector
nodes.summary: Dropdown section for choosing and persisting the AI model bound to the Telegram bot.

nodes.name: TraderConfigViewModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Read-only modal presenting a trader's configuration — avatar, AI model, exchange, initial balance, and status — with localized labels.

nodes.name: TraderConfigViewModal
nodes.summary: Displays trader details in labeled info rows using getTraderAvatar for the avatar and t() for localized field labels.

nodes.name: model-constants.ts
nodes.summary: Catalog of AI model and provider constants (CLAW402_MODELS, BLOCKRUN_MODELS, AI_PROVIDER_CONFIG) plus helpers for model/exchange display names, perp-DEX detection, wallet-address extraction, and address truncation.

nodes.name: getModelDisplayName
nodes.summary: Maps a model id to a friendly display name (e.g. deepseek → DeepSeek), defaulting to the uppercased id.

nodes.name: getShortName
nodes.summary: Returns the last segment of an underscore-separated identifier, used to shorten model/exchange ids.

nodes.name: getExchangeDisplayName
nodes.summary: Resolves a human-readable exchange label from the configured exchange list, falling back to a truncated uppercase id.

nodes.name: isPerpDexExchange
nodes.summary: Returns true when the exchange type is a perp DEX (hyperliquid, aster, lighter).

nodes.name: getWalletAddress
nodes.summary: Extracts the wallet address field appropriate to the perp-DEX exchange type from an exchange config.

nodes.name: truncateAddress
nodes.summary: Shortens a wallet address to leading/trailing segments with an ellipsis for display.

nodes.name: SettingsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings control surface listing exchange, AI-model, and Telegram configurations with status badges, opening the respective config modals for editing and reloading supported/configured lists through the api client.

nodes.name: configBadge
nodes.summary: Renders a small colored badge indicating whether a given configuration item (exchange/model) is active or unconfigured.

nodes.name: SettingsPage
nodes.summary: Main settings component fetching supported and user-configured exchanges/models/Telegram settings, rendering grouped sections with edit actions, and orchestrating ExchangeConfigModal, ModelConfigModal, and TelegramConfigModal state.
